verdicts.reason: Both reverse the headline to 'MAKEUP TRAVEL' and crop away most of the cosmetics framing, so the canvas is a mostly empty slate. A also has an arbitrary grey translucent band across the middle and leaves a large gap between the label row and the 'KIT' box. B is worse: 'KIT' has fallen out of its white box and sits on the lipstick at the bottom-left edge, and an empty white box floats inside a meaningless grey rectangle, so the headline is broken into scattered pieces.
